facts.function: blade/target on the crankshaft that a sensor reads to detect crankshaft position or speed

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8409 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with engines of heading 8407 or 8408; Section XVI note 2(b) puts parts identifiable as for a particular machine in that machine's heading

rejected_alternatives.reason: N270502 put a toothed sensor wheel for a vehicle there because it was not specifically provided for; here the blade is a dedicated part of a heading 8407 engine, so 8409 is more specific
crankshafts transmit power; a sensing blade does not
for the sensor itself (ruling 966732 type), not the passive blade
limited to cast-iron parts not advanced beyond cleaning

missing_facts: Material and whether the blade is used with a sensor or sold with it
classification.rationale: A sensing blade used in spark-ignition piston engines is an identifiable engine part. Heading 8409 and subheading 8409.91 cover it under GRI 1 and GRI 6, and the residual 8409.91.99.90 line applies. N270502 (sensor wheel, 7326) is contrary in outcome but concerned a vehicle part and was not engine-specific.
